requirements.requirement: A clean Win7 host installs and starts without an online download and with every prerequisite declared.
requirements.gap: Offline payload assembly is implemented; clean-host installation and first-start evidence are not performed.
requirements.action: Complete installer lifecycle scripts and execute RC-01 under a new signed Win7 lease.
requirements.acceptance: No network access, all locked payload files present, installer and first start exit zero on clean Win7.

requirements.requirement: Outer ZIP, release manifest and every runtime file have matching developer and Win7 SHA-256 values.
requirements.gap: Developer-side manifest and sidecar verification are implemented; Win7 certutil comparison is not performed.
requirements.action: Bind the final Win10 return hash, upload under the RC lease and compare every required hash with certutil.
requirements.acceptance: Developer verifier and Win7 coordinator independently report identical SHA-256 values.

requirements.requirement: Native modules are x64 ABI 110 and outside ASAR; locked PE/API/CRT evidence remains attached.
requirements.gap: External native layout and locked hashes are enforced; final Win10 PE/API/CRT revalidation is not performed.
requirements.action: Run the exact Win10 toolchain verification against the unique RC ZIP.
requirements.acceptance: No .node/helper/DLL exists under app or ASAR; ABI, x64 and forbidden API/CRT checks pass.

requirements.requirement: Electron, Core, low-risk Runner and local-SSD Storage start as one product and disabled capabilities are explicit.
requirements.gap: The current candidate 39eecb6a...040c9 passed two Windows 10 19045 product-entry smoke rounds (3/3 each, exit 0, no WAL/SHM or process residue) on 2026-08-16; the same RC-04 case has not run under a new signed Win7 RC lease.
requirements.action: Preserve the locked candidate and repeat RC-04 under the new Win7 RC lease after RC-05 is unblocked and the remaining developer and Win10 gates pass.
requirements.acceptance: Product smoke proves all four boundaries and reports disabled interactive terminal and unsupported media.

requirements.requirement: Only locked low-risk structured Runner profiles execute; interactive input, arbitrary shell and high-risk profiles are rejected.
requirements.gap: v4 Windows attempt (2026-08-16) passed: all six cases PASS except the expected RC05-P01 Win7 whoami hash deferral, giving PASS_WITH_WIN7_TARGET_PROFILE_DEFERRED on Windows 10 19045. findstr fixture probe proved CP936 decoding, 127-of-215-byte boundary-aligned truncation with zero replacement characters and loopback ping cooperative cancellation with verified Job/ACL rollback; the independent verifier bound kit, candidate, reports, databases and exit code 0. The same matrix has not run under a new signed Win7 RC lease, where RC05-P01 becomes executable with the real Win7 whoami bytes.
requirements.action: Repeat the RC-05 matrix under the new signed Win7 RC lease after RC-07/RC-08 and the final Win10 RC-03 closure; on Win7 the RC05-P01 product profile case must execute instead of deferring.
requirements.acceptance: Structured command/output/cancel/reap pass and all forbidden inputs fail closed.

requirements.requirement: WAL/FTS5 persistence survives restart and supports Unicode, bounded cleanup and the local SSD profile.
requirements.gap: The current candidate 39eecb6a...040c9 passed the full RC-06 matrix (7/7) twice on Windows 10 19045 local NTFS SSD (v3 and v4 rounds on 2026-08-16), with the production and intentionally corrupted databases returned and independently hash-bound (quick_check=ok); the same matrix has not run under a new signed Win7 RC lease.
requirements.action: Rerun RC-06 under the new Win7 RC lease together with the full RC matrix.
requirements.acceptance: RC-06 matrix passes on local NTFS SSD and rejects unsupported media claims.

requirements.requirement: Upgrade succeeds and injected failure restores the original version, data and manifest without mixed files.
requirements.gap: The v1 lifecycle kit implements side-by-side staging with strict manifest tree equality, wrapper-performed rename activation, injected staged-file corruption detection, injected post-activation corruption with byte-identical rollback and user-data invariance audits; it was built deterministically twice (0103998b...f1ff) bound to commit e10b2a1 and the unchanged candidate. A single Win10 delivery ZIP (9b49b6a1...f008ef2, built twice identically) packages the locked new candidate, the renamed previous-candidate byte copy and the lifecycle kit with a SHA-256 manifest and operator prompt; Windows execution of the three-scenario matrix has not been performed.
requirements.action: Run the three RC0708 upgrade rounds on Windows 10 per the kit README (previous f24d9a4 candidate as the install under test), return the evidence set and verify it with verify-rc0708-evidence.mjs; then repeat under the new Win7 RC lease.
requirements.acceptance: Success and injected-failure paths both preserve a single coherent version.

requirements.requirement: Uninstall removes product and transient resources with an explicit user-data retention policy and zero process/lock residue.
requirements.gap: The v1 lifecycle kit implements quarantine-hosted uninstall with a file-lock probe, explicit retain/purge user-data policy, host-aware zero-process audits and transcript-proven quarantine removal; the product creates no registry, service or PATH entries. A single Win10 delivery ZIP (9b49b6a1...f008ef2, built twice identically) includes the lifecycle kit with a SHA-256 manifest and operator prompt; Windows execution of both policy rounds has not been performed.
requirements.action: Run the retain and purge RC0708 uninstall rounds on Windows 10 per the kit README (fresh product re-extract before the purge round), return the evidence set and verify it; then repeat under the new Win7 RC lease.
requirements.acceptance: Product files and transient state are absent, retained user data matches policy and process/lock count is zero.

requirements.requirement: Bitvise and SSH 22 remain available before and after every round with no prohibited system mutation or reboot.
requirements.gap: A7 has not issued a Win7 lease or connected to the target.
requirements.action: Add RC-specific signed preflight/postflight and run only after developer and Win10 PASS.
requirements.acceptance: Both snapshots pass and prohibited mutation flags are false.
